scope: Incremental growth prefix proof and Arc LookScene transaction sharing
assumptions: Growth is made for the current atlas as documented by Compiled::apply and Atlas::grow; malformed growth first indices remain subject to existing debug assertion.
The approval is for the inspected apply mutation paths. Future methods that mutate old palettes, raw set words, font entries or descriptors must extend this proof.

proof_obligations.argument: Atlas::grow appends descriptors. Its only mutation of old descriptors is palette_bounds when palettes are appended. Helper snapshots and compares the old descriptor prefix in exactly that branch.

proof_obligations.field: Palette rows and global named-palette base
proof_obligations.argument: apply calls Atlas::grow, which appends palette entries and never changes page_size or named_palettes. Existing palette values and global index base therefore remain unchanged; palette-bound effects are separately checked.
SpriteSets::single and add append nonempty words; empty sets return shared ID zero without modifying words. No Growth operation overwrites old numeric records.

Helper rejects writes to existing sprite_ids and existing nonempty set names, including sprite-derived implicit sets. An old EMPTY alias is allowed only when the final explicit entry restores EMPTY. This matches final-state name semantics and does not expose a temporary mapping to readers.
All empty sets share ID zero, so the final empty-set blend can affect untouched EMPTY aliases. Helper checks the last empty entry against the original blend whenever old EMPTY aliases exist.
apply only extends the fonts vector with cloned immutable Arc faces. Old names, numeric indices and Arc identities cannot change through this method.

proof_obligations.field: Layer LUTs and named palette mappings
proof_obligations.argument: Growth may append layer values and replace a layer LUT entry for a set name. Submitted TileWorld owns its previous layer lookup table and resolved palette numbers, so this does not reinterpret old packets. Full preserves_render_prefix intentionally uses the same invariant.

Helper mutates only worker-owned Compiled metadata. It calls the same apply implementation exactly once, after unchanged renderer atlas commit. No atlas preparation/admission/retirement or allowance is changed, and the full ArtCommitted metadata snapshot remains owned independently. Palette-only temporary descriptor copy is CPU metadata, not hidden GPU storage.

refresh_shared creates a new immutable Arc only when contents differ. Mapping capture/restore/activate share the exact candidate Arc; no in-place mutation of pending data was added. Existing ID/configuration and input-revision gates remain unchanged.

evidence.differential_oracle: Retained full preserves_render_prefix; fixtures cover aliases, named/EMPTY sets and blend, palette descriptor rewrites, 512 growth chunks, old LUT ownership.
